def _get_hash_list(self, accounts_list):
        hash_list = []
        for account in accounts_list:
            hash = hashlib.md5()
            hash.update(str(account))
            temp_hash = hash.hexdigest()
            hash_list.append(temp_hash)
        return hash_list
